links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses (ARI, FRES, GFI) for hypogonadism patient questions
links.effect: Gemini produced significantly more readable responses (lower ARI and GFI, higher FRES) than ChatGPT and Claude (all p < 0.001); Claude was most accurate but less readable.
links.quote: Gemini generated significantly more readable responses, characterized by lower ARI and GFI values and higher FRES scores compared with ChatGPT and Claude (all p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to hypogonadism questions rated by two urologists
links.effect: Accuracy scores: Claude 1.80 ± 0.38, ChatGPT 1.55 ± 0.43, Gemini 1.32 ± 0.65 (p = 0.025); safety comparable across models (p = 0.895).
links.quote: Claude demonstrated the highest accuracy (1.80 ± 0.38), followed by ChatGPT (1.55 ± 0.43) and Gemini (1.32 ± 0.65) (p = 0.025).

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of accuracy, safety, and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) answering patient questions on hypogonadism evaluated offline by clinicians and readability formulas.
